purge_trigger: Agave purges older completed archives after the next archive has completed. The next write needs its own headroom.

installation_integration.packaging_requirement: Keep the bank-stream-v2 and direct-agave directories as siblings and package snapshot_budget.py. The installer copies the helper into the immutable bank-stream-v2 release, records its artifact hash, loads that copy, and rejects missing helpers, unsupported pinned binary flags or an insufficient current disk budget before any service stop.
installation_integration.effective_boundary: The installed unit prepares 1/1 retention, the disk gate and guarded loader for the next validator start. Running PID 2579205 still uses the previous defaults. The patch did not restart it.

startup_disk_gate.rule: Require current statvfs free space at least recovery minimum plus the larger of the configured next-archive floor and largest observed archive allocation.
startup_disk_gate.empty_directory_behavior: An existing empty snapshot directory can pass only with the configured write floor and recovery reserve. This permits a future snapshot fetch; it does not certify that the download, unpacking or replay will fit.
startup_disk_gate.missing_or_unreadable_directory_behavior: Fail closed without a file write or service operation.
startup_disk_gate.template_packaging_requirement: Install the exact reviewed snapshot_budget.py in the dated snapshot-budget-20261013 release before installing either validator template. Both templates run it through ExecStartPre. The bank v2 installer uses and hashes its own immutable release copy.
startup_disk_gate.runtime_behavior: The helper performs read-only checks. Systemd blocks the validator start when ExecStartPre returns nonzero. The installer also checks current disk budget before any service stop.

preservation_rule: Keep the newest completed full archive, its newest matching completed incremental archive, all equal newest identities, active temporary files and unknown paths.
deployment_limits: The patch did not restart validator PID 2579205. The unit changes apply at its next start.
A validator restart requires a separate downstream source handoff. The helper supports adoption of an existing healthy capture and resumption of a saved switch.
No snapshot was removed manually. Agave startup cleanup recovered space after the earlier ENOSPC crash.
Retention counts bound archive count, not archive bytes. Snapshot writes, internal snapshot state, accounts and other consumers need separate free-space checks.
The startup gate reserves at least128 GiB for the next archive and raises it to the largest observed archive allocation. This does not guarantee archive, account, ledger or unpacking capacity.
The startup gate blocks a start under sampled disk pressure. It cannot stop later growth in a running validator.
